title: Detecting Hope, Hate, and Emotion in Arabic Textual Speech and Multi-modal Memes Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of base and fine-tuned Large Language Models (such as GPT-4o-mini, Gemini Flash 2.5, and LLaMA) in detecting hate speech, offensive content, and stereotypes in Arabic textual speech and multi-modal memes using metrics like macro F1, precision, and recall scores.
